headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Vallox MVHR ventilation units, built on the vallox.js library.

name.title: Name
name.description: Leave blank to use the unit's own model name (e.g. "Vallox 110 MV"), detected automatically at startup.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the Vallox unit's built-in web server.

enableEveHistory.title: Enable Eve app history graphs
enableEveHistory.description: Logs temperature (and humidity, on the main accessory) to the Eve app's history graphs (Eve-only; invisible in the stock Home app) and backfills them from the unit's own on-device log at startup.
